listing_id.description: The Forge listing identity exactly as Forge publishes it (listing UUID from GET /api/v1/listings/{id}). Distinct from payment_uid: this is the listing being judged, never derived from or replaced by the payment identifier.

payment_uid.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte payment_uid from the on-chain Payment this SLA is bound to. A payment identifier, not a listing identity.
